<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> are an intermediate crafting resource used to make many later tier workstations, resources, and equipment.  They can be made from [[iron ingot]]s and [[simple iron parts]] at either metal [[anvil]], or purchased from the blacksmith [[Krezvold]].
